line.s_cups.text: We have to put the cups away in the cupboard. Best one inside another.

line.s_big_into_small.text: Easy! I put this big one into the small one.

line.s_wont_fit.text: A big one will not fit into a small one! That does not work.

line.s_how.text: Then how do I do it?

line.s_order.text: Put them in order! From the smallest to the biggest.

line.s_show.text: I will show you. In the first place, here on the left, we put the smallest, then bigger and bigger.

line.s_fill.text: Drag the cups to their places. The smallest first.

line.wrong_order.text: That is not its place. Look which one is smaller.

line.wrong_order.lisek.text: That is not its place. Look which one is smaller.

line.s_nest.text: Now I see! The small one goes into the middle one, and the middle one into the big one.

line.s_solved.text: They all fit one inside another. That is how putting things in order works!

line.s_to_garden.text: Let's go to the garden and pull out some carrots.

line.b_carrots.text: I pulled out some carrots. Each one is a different length.

line.b_fill.text: Put them from the shortest to the longest.

line.b_done.text: From the shortest to the longest, like stairs!

line.b_to_room.text: And now to the room, we will build a tower.

line.c_tower.text: Let's build a tower of blocks that will not fall over.

line.c_fill.text: The biggest goes at the bottom and the smallest on top. Drag the blocks.

line.c_solved.text: The tower stands! The biggest at the bottom, the smallest on top.

line.p_intro.text: Let's play putting things in order!

line.p_from_small.text: Put them from the smallest to the biggest.

line.p_from_small.sarenka.text: Put them from the smallest to the biggest.

line.p_from_big.text: Put them from the biggest to the smallest.

line.p_from_big.sarenka.text: Put them from the biggest to the smallest.

line.a_game.text: Let's play putting things in order in the hallway.

line.a_ok.text: All right! We will sort the whole family's things.

line.a_shoes.text: Put the shoes from the smallest to the biggest.

line.a_socks.text: Now the socks, from the biggest to the smallest.

line.a_bears.text: And the teddies from the smallest to the biggest.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to line up the whole family's shoes with you, from the smallest to the biggest.

line.wrong_order_big.text: That is not its place. Look which one is bigger.

line.wrong_order_big.lisek.text: That is not its place. Look which one is bigger.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for our adventure together! Here's a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the little shoe from Deer. We got it when we put things in order.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you soon!
